segments.name: Online legal services
segments.description: An online platform offering technology-enabled legal, compliance and business management services to individuals and small businesses across the U.S.
segments.evidence: Our Chief Executive Officer, as the Chief Operating Decision Maker, or CODM, organizes our company, manages resource allocations, and measures performance on the basis of our one operating segment.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay LegalZoom flat fees for one-time transaction products and recurring subscription fees for legal, compliance and business management services.
revenueModel.evidence: For the year ended December 31, 2025, approximately 65% of our revenue was derived from subscriptions.
